canvas-cream.$description: Canvas Cream — Page background — warm off-white instead of pure white gives the entire system a paper-like, approachable feel

surface-ivory.$description: Surface Ivory — Card and panel surfaces — one step brighter than canvas to create subtle elevation without shadows

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Elevated surfaces, nav background, button text on filled CTAs

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Decorative wash behind icons or highlight badges — cool counterpoint to the warm cream canvas

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Outlined/ghost button border, subtle blue-tinted dividers within product UI

ink-charcoal.$description: Ink Charcoal — Primary text, headings, icons — near-black with a cool blue undertone (17.9:1 on white)

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — Secondary text, dark surface fills for footer or dark mode moments

mid-graphite.$description: Mid Graphite — Dark surface for dark UI moments (footer dark blocks, modal overlays)

slate-gray.$description: Slate Gray — Secondary body text, card metadata, table labels

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Muted helper text, placeholder text, disabled states

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders and dividers — barely-there separation between cards and sections

faint-gray.$description: Faint Gray — Icon strokes in nav, subdued borders on neutral controls

electric-cobalt.$description: Electric Cobalt — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-cobalt.$description: Deep Cobalt — Pressed/hover state for Electric Cobalt buttons — darker shade of the brand blue

cerulean.$description: Cerulean — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

vivid-violet.$description: Vivid Violet — Decorative accent — secondary brand color for highlight tags, illustrative elements, and customer logo treatments

forest.$description: Forest — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

roobert.$description: All text — single typeface carries the entire system. Headlines use 600–700 at 48–84px with extremely tight leading (1.06–1.09) creating dense, confident type blocks. Body and nav use 400–500 at 14–16px with generous 1.50–1.60 leading for readability on the cream background.
